Subject: Decision needed: six-week invoice-handling pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m asking for your approval of the six-week invoice-handling pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance before any access to client data.

This pilot is deliberately bounded: it assesses invoice handling only and excludes production rollout. It aligns with your goal of 20% shorter handling time while recognizing that no baseline or measured savings exists yet; the pilot is the right next step to test feasibility without expanding commitment.

Because no start date has been approved, we can sequence kickoff after security approval and your sign-off.

Please confirm approval of scope and fee, conditional on security clearance, and identify any final requirements needed to set a start date.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead

input.prompt:
Write an email to Morgan, the client operations director, proposing the approved pilot and requesting the next decision. Make the proposal persuasive enough to move the discussion forward.

SOURCE PACK (all facts are synthetic):
{
  "scope": "Six-week pilot to assess invoice handling. Production rollout is excluded.",
  "fee": "$30,000 fixed fee for the pilot.",
  "target": "Client hopes for 20% shorter handling time. No baseline or measured savings exists.",
  "security": "Security approval is required before access to client data.",
  "schedule": "No start date has been approved.",
  "decision": "Ask Morgan to approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance.",

Use only this source pack for factual claims. Produce the requested deliverable only. Maximum 180 whitespace-separated words, including titles and tables.
